describes: packages/plugin/actions: trigger resolution, page fan-out and the lifecycle cache.

cases.name: activate-resolves-the-annotation-tree
cases.covers: An activate trigger resolves current objectNumber and stable baseIndex refs on their own pages; mismatched kinds, pages and absent refs find nothing. Historical NM/revision-index spellings are archived.

cases.name: annotation-events-resolve-their-aa-tree
cases.covers: Each of the six /AA pointer events resolves its own tree; absence is silently inert; the hover pair is hover-origin and the rest are user-origin.

cases.name: a-source-hint-is-provenance-only
cases.covers: A first-party source hint becomes the step source, and the origin is still derived from the trigger.

cases.name: a-precedes-aa-u
cases.covers: /A shadows the /AA U tree: a mouseUp on an annotation with /A is inert; without /A its U tree runs.

cases.name: an-incomplete-trigger-tree-is-refused
cases.covers: A rootless but incomplete tree still becomes a step, and the step is refused; the trigger folds to refused.

diagnostics.message: refused: the action tree is incomplete

cases.name: resolution-never-rejects
cases.covers: A failed annotation read and an unknown page both come back refused with trigger-failed; dispatch never rejects.

cases.name: submission-order-is-execution-order
cases.covers: Two dispatches run in call order even when the first read is slower.

cases.name: page-fan-out-order
cases.covers: open runs page /O then the /PO set; close runs the /PC set then /C; visible and invisible fan only their sets; rootless trees and tree-less annotations are no steps.

cases.name: a-failed-step-never-skips-its-siblings
cases.covers: A /PC step that fails is partial; the page /C still runs, and the trigger folds to partial.

cases.name: single-tree-lifecycle-annotations
cases.covers: An annotation bearing only one lifecycle tree (close, visible or invisible) is still in the lifecycle set.

cases.name: an-all-inert-fan-out-is-inert
cases.covers: Steps that all come back inert fold to inert.

cases.name: deferred-navigation-flushes-per-step
cases.covers: A page /O goto fires inside its own step, before the /PO step runs.

cases.name: lifecycle-cache-and-invalidation
cases.covers: Lifecycle trees are read once per page; confirmed annotations.updated for that page and stream.desynced clear the cache, other events do not; close unsubscribes.
cases.reason: Pins when lifecycle trees are read and which trigger families fire, through the engine reads and the dispatch outcomes. Its dispatched actions are compared; the state they build is not.

cases.name: trigger-gates
cases.covers: Disabled families are inert with trigger-disabled and canDispatch false; activate is never gated.

diagnostics.message: page: trigger family disabled by config
annotation: trigger family disabled by config
document: trigger family disabled by config

cases.name: gates-default-open
cases.covers: A triggers object with no families set leaves every family enabled.
